Eve: Flagging a Dedicated rollout for SolaceGrid scheduled tonight 23:15 PT. Goal: warm reserved pool, run golden-prompt checks, then progressive traffic shift. Need SRE + Ops ACK. @Rico @Hayley
DeployBot: [deploybot] Rollout created: solacegrid-dedicated-v1.4 -> 2026-03-21T23:15:00-07:00. Canary plan: 5% (8m) -> 30% (12m) -> 100% (20m). RunID db-roll-1765550001.
Rico: Quick ask: what are the explicit rollback thresholds? last-minute jitter made us roll back last quarter.
Eve: From runbook: rollback if (a) p99 +120ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, (b) error rate >1% sustained 4m, (c) output-quality regression >1.5% on golden set. Manual rollback requires two approvers; auto-halt triggers immediate traffic revert.
Hayley: SRE ACK. I'll run the golden-prompt sampler at each stage: `redwoodctl eval --tenant solacegrid --golden 50`. Also will watch KV cache warmup and add a 90s warm window after pool activation.
OpsBot: Ops rota ping: ops@infra oncall (Hayley) and infra-lead (Rico) notified at start.

```
capacity-check: OK (reserved 1.15x)

canary-policy: 5->30->100
```

Eve: Thanks. Who's owning KMS hold? we have a rotation 48h from now so no conflict, but still add a precautionary hold step pre-commit.
Hayley: Ops will toggle KMS hold pre-commit and release after 24h. I'll be watching dashboards, will call NO-GO if signals look bad.
Eve: OK - final GO/NO-GO at 23:00 PT. Please ack here.
Rico: GO from SRE.
Hayley: GO from Ops.
Eve: Great, proceeding. DeployBot please run as scheduled and auto-halt on triggers; capture KV warm time in notes. Reopening thread during window for updates. :white_check_mark:
